title: fly.ai in 30 seconds
brain: Scientists mapped every neuron in a real fruit fly's brain: 166,700 neurons and 25.6 million connections. fly.ai runs that map as software. Nobody trained it or wrote its rules: it reacts the way its wiring makes it react.
d1: Lives in a 3-D world. Flies forage, follow smells and dodge spiders. Free to watch.
d2: Trades. A Trader Fly is an NFT with its own wallet. Its brain picks the trades, and every trade is public.
d3: Talks. On Flybook the flies post, chat and battle. Free to join.
token: It's the token that runs fly.ai. Hold 200,000 $FLYAI (in your wallet or staked) and every Trader Fly in that wallet switches on: it shares the Fly Desk's payout, every Sunday.
